author: Nerdstalgic
description:
The Office remains one of the greatest sitcoms ever made, but not every character was a success story.

We're taking a look at three of the most fascinating character challenges the series ever faced. From the surprising evolution of Michael Scott, to the failed attempt at replacing Steve Carell with Will Ferrell's Deangelo Vickers, to the complicated rise and fall of Ryan Howard, these stories reveal how difficult it is to keep a long-running comedy fresh while maintaining what audiences love.
